watches.name: Monarch - Carbon Black
watches.description: Monarch is our newest model, created for the moments when you want your watch to feel like more than a tool. It begins with a confident integrated silhouette that sits cleanly on the wrist and carries a quiet sense of authority. Light moves across the brushed steel and crisp chamfers as you move, revealing the craftsmanship in a way that feels intentional rather than loud. Under sapphire crystal, the dial is built with depth and character. Applied markers add structure, bold details bring rhythm, and luminous hands keep the story going after dark. Each colorway shifts the mood, from modern Pantone tones to forged carbon with a darker edge, but the purpose stays the same. Monarch is designed to be noticed at first glance and appreciated over time. At its core, an automatic movement keeps time with a steady mechanical heartbeat. Monarch is the start of a new chapter for CAUGHT, a watch made to carry your presence and catch the moment you are living in.

watches.name: Grand Slammer 1959 - Beige
watches.description: Racing spirit, refined for everyday wear A racing-inspired chronograph with a clean panda-design character, the Grand Slammer Collection brings vintage motorsport energy into a more refined everyday form. Bold enough to stand out, balanced enough to wear with ease, it is designed for those who appreciate strong design, tactile details, and a watch that feels just as natural on the wrist as it does in the moment.

watches.name: Nomad - Blue/Red
watches.description: Nomad – Time Across Borders Nomad is where movement becomes meaning. Designed for those who carry many places within them, it bridges time zones with ease and quiet confidence. Built for those who live between time zones, the GMT function anchors past and future in a single glance. Nomad embodies the spirit of those who are always in motion, yet always at home. It’s not just a watch. It’s a passport in motion.
